name: Pleasure DVR
blurb: Pleasure DVR is a software system designed to record video streams from Chaturbate.
description:
Pleasure DVR is a software system designed to record video streams from Chaturbate. The application supports multiple simultaneous recordings, customizable video quality settings.

The software can capture several streamers at once, letting you adjust resolution, bitrate and container format to suit your needs. It automatically starts recording when a selected streamer goes live and stops when the broadcast ends.

The backend relies on the open-source goodvr engine, which handles stream capture, segmentation, and storage.
